description:
The catalogue of known code-level BREAKING CHANGES to watch for when writing or porting
    a custom module for a target Odoo major - the same signatures the migration engine uses,
    exposed as guidance you can apply BEFORE the code breaks. Each entry: what breaks, how to
    spot it (a grep signature), where it applies (py/xml/security), and the documented fix. Plus
    a per-model summary of fields removed on the way to the target. READ-ONLY.

    This is the 'don't write code that will break on major N' advisor, not tied to running a
    migration. For a specific model's field changes use odoo_version_diff.
name: odoo_breaking_changes
